description: This file defines a singleton class 'CronJobsStore' that manages scheduled cron jobs, their statuses, and event handling within an application, utilizing Swift's concurrency features and system logs.

classes.name: CronJobsStore
classes.description: A singleton class that handles the storage, updating, and event handling of cron jobs and their logs, with methods to start/stop polling, refresh data, and process external events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins polling and event subscriptions for cron jobs if not in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing polling and event tasks related to cron jobs.

methods.name: refreshJobs
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of cron jobs and updates internal state.

methods.name: refreshRuns
methods.description: Fetches latest run logs for a specific job.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Triggers execution of a cron job, optionally forcing it to run.

methods.name: removeJob
methods.description: Removes a specific cron job and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: setJobEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a particular cron job.

methods.name: upsertJob
methods.description: Creates or updates a cron job with the given payload.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Processes incoming push notifications related to events, particularly cron events.

methods.name: handle(cronEvent:)
methods.description: Handles specific cron-related events, scheduling refreshes based on the event actions.

methods.name: scheduleRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of cron jobs.

methods.name: scheduleRunsRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of run logs for a specific job.
